package api

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/kausys/apikit"
)

func serve(t *testing.T, method, target, body string, header http.Header) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	t.Helper()
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.Handle("GET /items", listAPIKit(List))
	mux.Handle("GET /items/{id}", getAPIKit(Get))
	mux.Handle("POST /items", createAPIKit(Create))
	mux.Handle("POST /webhook", webhookAPIKit(Webhook))
	mux.Handle("PATCH /items/{id}", renameAPIKit(Rename))
	r := httptest.NewRequest(method, target, strings.NewReader(body))
	for k, v := range header {
		r.Header[k] = v
	}
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	return w
}

func decode(t *testing.T, w *httptest.ResponseRecorder) map[string]any {
	t.Helper()
	var m map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &m); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decoding %q: %v", w.Body.String(), err)
	}
	return m
}

func TestPointersSlicesDefaultsAndHeaders(t *testing.T) {
	w := serve(t, "GET", "/items?active=true&name=ana&kind=a&kind=b&size=1&size=2&since=2026-01-02T03:04:05Z", "",
		http.Header{"X-Trace": {"t1", "t2"}})
	if w.Code != 200 {
		t.Fatalf("status %d: %s", w.Code, w.Body)
	}
	got := decode(t, w)
	if got["limit"] != float64(20) || got["status"] != "active" {
		t.Errorf("defaults not applied: %v", got)
	}
	if got["active"] != true || got["name"] != "ana" {
		t.Errorf("pointers not bound: %v", got)
	}
	if len(got["kinds"].([]any)) != 2 || len(got["sizes"].([]any)) != 2 || len(got["trace"].([]any)) != 2 {
		t.Errorf("slices not bound: %v", got)
	}
	if got["since"] != "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z" {
		t.Errorf("time not bound: %v", got)
	}
}

func TestBadValueIs400(t *testing.T) {
	if w := serve(t, "GET", "/items?limit=many", "", nil); w.Code != 400 {
		t.Errorf("status %d, want 400", w.Code)
	}
}

func TestTypedPathID(t *testing.T) {
	if w := serve(t, "GET", "/items/itm_1", "", nil); w.Code != 200 || !strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), "itm_1") {
		t.Errorf("status %d: %s", w.Code, w.Body)
	}
	if w := serve(t, "GET", "/items/usr_1", "", nil); w.Code != 400 {
		t.Errorf("foreign id: status %d, want 400", w.Code)
	}
	if w := serve(t, "GET", "/items/itm_missing", "", nil); w.Code != 404 {
		t.Errorf("handler refusal: status %d, want 404", w.Code)
	}
}

func TestBodyIsDecodedAndValidated(t *testing.T) {
	w := serve(t, "POST", "/items", `{"name":"lamp","price":3}`, nil)
	if w.Code != 201 || decode(t, w)["name"] != "lamp" {
		t.Fatalf("status %d: %s", w.Code, w.Body)
	}
	if w := serve(t, "POST", "/items", `{"name":"x"}`, nil); w.Code != 422 {
		t.Errorf("rule on the body: status %d, want 422", w.Code)
	}
}

func TestBodyIsReadWithJSONv2(t *testing.T) {
	if w := serve(t, "POST", "/items", `{"name":"lamp","name":"desk"}`, nil); w.Code != 400 {
		t.Errorf("duplicate member: status %d, want 400", w.Code)
	}
	if w := serve(t, "POST", "/items", `{"NAME":"lamp"}`, nil); w.Code != 422 {
		t.Errorf("another case is another name, so name is missing: status %d, want 422", w.Code)
	}
}

func TestBodyOverTheLimitIs413(t *testing.T) {
	apikit.SetMaxBodyBytes(16)
	t.Cleanup(func() { apikit.SetMaxBodyBytes(0) })
	if w := serve(t, "POST", "/webhook", strings.Repeat("x", 64), nil); w.Code != 413 {
		t.Errorf("status %d, want 413", w.Code)
	}
	if w := serve(t, "POST", "/webhook", "short", nil); w.Body.String() != "\"5\"\n" {
		t.Errorf("raw body: %q", w.Body)
	}
}

func TestPayloadFromAnotherPackage(t *testing.T) {
	w := serve(t, "PATCH", "/items/itm_9", `{"name":"desk"}`, nil)
	if w.Code != 200 || !strings.Contains(w.Body.String(), "itm_9:desk") {
		t.Errorf("status %d: %s", w.Code, w.Body)
	}
}
